topic_relevance.basis: Conditional order/essential supremum is least range-measurable upper envelope, not joint-parametric argmax selection or analytic projection theorem.

definitions.name: Conditional Riesz triple (E,e,F)
definitions.statement: E Dedekind complete Riesz space, weak order unite; F strictlypositive ordercontinuous linear projection, Fe=e, Dedekindcomplete range R(F). L∞(F) consists of elements orderbounded by some R(F) element.

definitions.name: Conditional sup/inf and range oscillation
definitions.statement: M_F(f)=inf{g∈R(F):f≤g}; m_F(f)=sup{g∈R(F):g≤f}; δ=M−m. Norm is M_F(|f|), R(F)-valued.

theorem_cards.label: Propositions3–5 (order envelope and tower)
assumptions: f,g∈L∞(F); tower G conditional expectation with GF=FG=F
theorem_cards.statement: M is monotone,idempotent,positivelyhomogeneous,subadditive; translation by R(F) element commutes; |M(f)−M(g)|≤M(|f−g|); m(f)≤Ff≤M(f); M_F(M_G f)=M_F f=M_G(M_F f).
proof_steps: Minimal upper-bound definition; applying F to sandwich; rangeinclusion R(F)⊂R(G) and monotonicity give tower.
gaps: These are order-envelope results; no index-dependent argmax or measurable-point-selector provided.

theorem_cards.label: Lemma11 / Proposition12 (limits)
assumptions: Net fα↑f in L∞(F) for M continuity; f≥0 for Lp limit
theorem_cards.statement: M_F(fα)↑M_F(f) for increasing net. Decreasing fα does not in general imply decreasing M→M(f). For f∈L∞(F)+, source cites prior work for lim_{p→∞}F(f^p)^(1/p)=M_F(f).
proof_steps: f=sup fα≤sup M fα∈R(F), compare to minimalupperenvelope
Lp-limit is reported from [4], not proved in thissource
gaps: Must retain directional monotonicity; a.s./orderconvergence alone cannot commute M with arbitrary limits.

theorem_cards.label: Theorem25 (half-oscillation range-distance)
assumptions: Distance infimum in R(F)-valued norm, not general scalar Banach norm
proof_steps: Lipschitzδ estimate Prop24 gives δ(f)≤2||f−g|| for g∈R(F)
gaps: Source proof p18 prints δ(f)≤||f−g||, omitting 2. Correct Prop24 estimate δ(f)≤2||f−g|| immediately yields δ(f)/2≤d(f,R(F)); midpoint gives opposite bound. Thus d=δ/2 is verified locally, not an erroneous conclusion.

theorem_cards.label: Theorem29 / Proposition33 (financial application)
assumptions: Finite adapted self-financing process in conditionalRieszfiltration, source financial definitions
NA equivalence Proposition33 adds strict inequalities for each positive component
theorem_cards.statement: Sourcecharacterizes AIP by m_Ft(S_{t+1})≤S_t≤M_Ft(S_{t+1}); additional strict hypotheses used for NA equivalence.
proof_steps: Sign-split θ via M(hf)=h+M(f)−h−m(f); backward tower/translationargument controls portfolio infimum.
gaps: Prop33 p23 sets p=(θ+²∧e) and calls it a component; that expression generally is not a component. No source-wide NA certificate accepted from this sketch.
theorem_cards.usable_scope: The order-envelope sign/tower method may be studied conditionally; Proposition33 no-arbitrage equivalence may not be called as a certified research tool from this proof.
